mapper.select: select * from tb_media_asset where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update tb_media_asset set status = 'TEMP', expires_at = #{expiresAt}, delete_after = null, update_time = #{updateTime}, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status = 'UPLOADING'
update tb_media_asset set status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, delete_after = #{deleteAfter}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'UPLOADING'

update tb_media_asset set status = 'BOUND', bound_type = #{boundType}, bound_id = #{boundId}, bound_at = #{boundAt}, expires_at = null, delete_after = null, update_time = #{boundAt} where id = #{id} and status = 'TEMP'
mapper.select: select id from tb_media_asset where (status = 'TEMP' and expires_at <= #{now}) or (status in ('UPLOADING', 'PENDING_DELETE', 'FAILED') and delete_after <= #{now}) order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update tb_media_asset set status = 'DELETED', delete_after = null, last_error = null, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_DELETE'

update tb_media_asset set last_error = #{lastError}, delete_retry_count = delete_retry_count + 1, delete_after = #{deleteAfter}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_DELETE'
